source.publisher: University of Hawaii Economic Research Organization (UHERO)
source.title: The Hawai‘i Housing Factbook 2026 (fourth edition)
source.data_book_location_in_report: Report PDF pp. 17-21 (printed) = Data Dictionary/technical notes; profile pages: State printed p.22, Counties p.23-26, ZIP codes p.27+ (PDF pages 26-95). Standalone DataBook PDF pages 1-70 are the same 70 profiles.
source.underlying_data: Title Guaranty (deed transfer / recorded transaction data, 2025) for prices, transactions and out-of-state share; DBEDT STR records 2025; ACS 2020-2024 5-year; county zoning maps and permit records
source.parsed_from: TheHawaiiHousingFactbook2026_DataBook.pdf via pdftotext -layout (regex on labelled fields) + pdfplumber nav-tab shading for county section; cross-checked against report PDF profile pages

period: 2025 (Title Guaranty recorded transactions; UHERO data dictionary: 'Date of Data Collection 2025', 'transactions over the past year')

definitions.out_of_state_share_sf / out_of_state_sha: UHERO data dictionary: 'Out-of state buyer share' = 'The share of transactions over the past year where the buyer listed an out-of-state home address on the deed transfer documents.' Source Title Guaranty, 2025. Reported separately for single-family and condominium transactions.
definitions.out_of_state_share: DERIVED here (not published by UHERO): (sf_share*sf_tx + condo_share*condo_tx)/(sf_tx + condo_tx) using printed 1-decimal shares; error up to ~0.05pp. Use the published SF/condo shares when citing UHERO.
definitions.out_of_state_buyers_*_implied: DERIVED: round(published share * published transaction count). Because shares are k/n rounded to 0.1%, these recover the integer counts (checked: share*n within rounding of an integer for every row).
definitions.sf_transactions / condo_transactions: Number of single-family / condominium transactions in the past year (2025), Title Guaranty; transactions under $50,000 (current-dollar equivalent) omitted. Condo count includes townhomes, duplexes and units in any building with more than one unit. Includes new homes and resales.
definitions.median_sf_price / median_condo_price: Median price across recorded 2025 SF / condo transactions (Title Guaranty), excluding transactions < $50,000.
definitions.repeat_sales_index: UHERO repeat-sales index, 2000=100, SF and condo combined, Title Guaranty 1986-2025.
definitions.active_strs: Active short-term vacation rentals 2025 (DBEDT STR records): whole-home listings on all major STR platforms incl. Airbnb; excludes hotel rooms and single-room listings; may include resort/time-share units advertised on STR platforms.
definitions.str_share_of_housing: Active STRs (2025) divided by ACS 2020-2024 housing units. This is the factbook's 'vacation-rental share' at ZIP level.
definitions.geography: ZIP = Census ZCTA boundaries (not USPS ZIP); all data conform to ZCTA boundaries except Craigslist rents (by listing ZIP).
definitions.ranks: Rank 1 = highest value; ZIP ranks among ZIPs with data (SF /65, condo /56); county ranks /4. Ties share a rank.
definitions.null: Printed '-' (insufficient data) is stored as null.

notes: Edition: The Hawai‘i Housing Factbook 2026, dated May 7, 2026 (report PDF CreationDate 2026-05-06; DataBook PDF CreationDate 2026-04-22). Landing page modified 2026-07-03; PDFs carry ?v= cache-busting params.

Period: all transaction-based fields (prices, counts, out-of-state shares) cover 2025 ('past year' in the data dictionary; body text: 'Single-family Home Sales in 2025'). STR counts are 2025; housing-unit denominators and demographics are ACS 2020-2024.

Out-of-state definition is based on the buyer's home address written on the deed transfer documents (Title Guaranty data), not on residency, citizenship or later occupancy. A local buyer listing a mainland address, or an out-of-state buyer who lists the Hawaii property address, would be misclassified. The dictionary does not say whether foreign (non-US) addresses are counted as out-of-state; no foreign vs mainland split and no origin-state breakdown is published.

No XLSX/CSV is published for the 2026 Factbook: the landing page links only the report PDF and the DataBook PDF, and the WordPress media API (search 'factbook' and all uploads 2026-04-15..2026-07-15) lists only these two PDFs for 2026 (other xlsx files that period are UHERO forecast tables). The DataBook PDF is the data appendix; values were parsed from it.

Cross-check: the 70 profile pages in the report PDF (pp.26-95) were parsed independently and match the DataBook on every extracted field (0 diffs). Body-text figures also match (county SF medians/transactions, top/bottom ZIP medians, county STR shares).

Coverage: 65 ZIP pages (Hawaii County 18, Honolulu 27, Kauai 10, Maui 10). Very small ZIPs are omitted entirely, e.g. no pages for Hanalei 96714, Hana 96713 or Eleele 96705; sums of ZIP transactions are therefore below county totals (see checks.zip_coverage_vs_county_totals). Sum of county transactions is slightly below the state total (SF 6,567 vs 6,573; condo 8,160 vs 8,194; STRs 34,515 vs 34,514); the source does not explain the gap (possibly records not assigned to a county, or rounding).

Small samples: shares are k/n of very few deeds in many ZIPs (e.g., Anahola 96703 SF 66.7% = 4 of 6; Hawaiian Paradise Park 96749 and Discovery Harbour 96772 condo 100% = 1 of 1; Lanai City 96763 SF 37.5% = 3 of 8). UHERO warns small-ZIP data are volatile and outlier-driven. Use counts (sf_transactions, condo_transactions) as weights.

Two places named Waimea: 96743 (Hawaii County, Big Island) and 96796 (Kauai). Kaunakakai 96748 (Molokai) and Lanai City 96763 are in Maui County. ZIP names are UHERO's labels (e.g., 96706 is labelled '‘Ewa Gentry', 96707 'Makakilo').

Anomalies printed as-is: Lihue 96766 median condo price $62,900 (143 condo transactions) vs Kauai County $833,000 - likely composition (fractional/timeshare/leasehold transfers) but not explained in the source; Paia 96779 condo median $3,833,333 on 5 sales; Princeville 96722 STR share 79.8% and Koloa 96756 51.0% (STR counts include resort/time-share units advertised on platforms, denominator is ACS housing units).
The UHERO profiles show only SF and condo shares, not land or commercial; 'Out-of-state buyer share' rank for condo uses denominator 56 ZIPs.
Privacy: output is aggregate only (ZIP/county/state); the source contains no owner names.

Prior editions (not downloaded): 2025 factbook https://uhero.hawaii.edu/the-hawaii-housing-factbook-2025/ (data PDF TheHousingFactbook2025_Data.pdf) and 2024 - could be used for year-over-year comparison of the same fields.
